scope: Targeted systematic review of geometric coherent optical computation with native GPU ray tracing, verified numerical bounds and photonic-network antecedents
queries: coherent optical ray tracing GPU numerical error phase precision
robust ray triangle intersection interval arithmetic exact predicates
photonic neural network three dimensional programmable glass
photonic neural network on chip backpropagation in situ training
verified ray tracing coherent field error bounds path merging
additional_searches: required owner DOIs and backward/forward citations from most relevant primary papers
include: Primary research or authoritative numerical/optical methods directly relevant to coherent transport, robust geometry, bounded arithmetic, photonic implementation or their comparison baselines
exclude: Unrelated application with no relevant method; duplicate version; marketing-only material as research evidence; sources lacking verifiable identity
full_text_requirement: Extract evidence for each novelty-relevant assertion from accessible primary full text or label abstract-only/unavailable; do not convert access failure into absence of prior work
heterogeneous_metrics: Do not rank unlike tasks/units as one SOTA leaderboard
novelty_rule: Describe demonstrated overlap and residual candidate difference; absence in bounded search cannot prove absolute novelty
completion: Search logs and failures retained; screening/dedup/extraction traceable; at least5 comparable-method entries plus gap/overlap verdict; inaccessible direct prior art remains explicit limitation
